import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots to show comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_clean = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for disorder in sleep_disorder_clean.unique():
    mask = sleep_disorder_clean == disorder
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Sleep Duration'], df[mask]['Quality of Sleep'], 
               label=disorder, alpha=0.6, s=50)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Distribution of Sleep Disorders
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
sleep_disorder_counts = sleep_disorder_clean.value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(sleep_disorder_counts))
ax2.pie(sleep_disorder_counts.values, labels=sleep_disorder_counts.index, 
        autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Physical Activity Level vs Stress Level
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                     c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', alpha=0.6, s=50)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Quality', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1:])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
colors_occ = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(occupation_sleep))
occupation_sleep.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax4, color=colors_occ)
ax4.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 5. BMI Category distribution by Gender
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
bmi_gender = pd.crosstab(df['BMI Category'], df['Gender'])
bmi_gender.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, color=['#FF9999', '#66B2FF'])
ax5.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_title('BMI Category by Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend(title='Gender')
ax5.set_xticklabels(ax5.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Heart Rate vs Daily Steps
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
ax6.scatter(df['Daily Steps'], df['Heart Rate'], alpha=0.5, c=df['Age'], cmap='coolwarm', s=50)
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate vs Daily Steps', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
cbar2 = plt.colorbar(ax6.collections[0], ax=ax6)
cbar2.set_label('Age', fontsize=9)
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 7. Sleep Quality Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
sleep_quality_dist = df['Quality of Sleep'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax7.bar(sleep_quality_dist.index, sleep_quality_dist.values, color='steelblue', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_xlabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11)
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11)
ax7.set_title('Sleep Quality Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
